_readme: Fifty museums with measured artifact slots. Written by tools/museum_50.py from commons/data/template_patterns.json. A slot says where a thing COULD stand and how big it may be; it places nothing.

enfilade.why: a walk down a spine: one hero at the end of the vista, the rest hung on the walls you pass

cabinet.why: Soane's answer — every niche holds one made thing, and nothing stands in the middle

free_plan.why: Mies: the floor is continuous, so a thing is an island you walk around, never a picture on a wall

field.why: Dia:Beacon — many equal things across an open floor, no hierarchy and no centre

hypostyle.why: the Mezquita: the columns make the rhythm, so things come in pairs between them

crypt.why: a narrow run where the walls close in — what you meet, you meet at arm's length

drum.why: the panorama: ONE thing, and the room is the frame around it
